raw_posts.name: /dev/null
raw_posts.description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

raw_posts.name: Composio Instant
raw_posts.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
raw_posts.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

raw_posts.name: Hoistbay
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
raw_posts.description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

raw_posts.name: Harness²
raw_posts.tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
raw_posts.description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

raw_posts.name: Exa 3.0
raw_posts.tagline: Smarter search that gives AI agent richer data at lower cost
raw_posts.description: Exa 3.0 is the biggest search quality update to Exa’s search API for AI agents. It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

raw_posts.name: Mintlify Autopilot
raw_posts.tagline: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date
raw_posts.description: Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

raw_posts.name: Asimov 1
raw_posts.tagline: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy
raw_posts.description: Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Train it and shape it for whatever you're building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

raw_posts.name: RunInfra
raw_posts.description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

raw_posts.name: Inflight
raw_posts.tagline: The missing feedback layer for prototypes
raw_posts.description: Share a preview link or HTML prototype. Reviewers pin comments to real elements, or record video, right on the running app. Inflight turns that feedback into next steps your coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) pulls in over MCP.

raw_posts.name: ToDo.is
raw_posts.tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
raw_posts.description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.
